title.en: Constantine on a surviving bronze coin
title.zh: 现存铜币上的君士坦丁

alt.en: A bronze coin shows a right-facing head with a laurel wreath, surrounded by a worn inscription and patches of green corrosion.
alt.zh: 铜币上是头戴月桂冠的右向侧面头像，周围有磨损铭文与绿色锈斑。

caption.en: Unknown maker, Coin of Constantine I, 307–337 CE. Bronze; Getty 80.NH.152.228. The surviving coin carries an imperial portrait from the reign of the ruler named in these entries.
caption.zh: 佚名制作者，《君士坦丁一世钱币》，公元307—337年。青铜；盖蒂80.NH.152.228。现存钱币保留了本组条目所述统治者在位时期的皇帝肖像。

interpretation.en: This contemporary coin supplies a material image of Constantine, whose actions connect the Milan arrangements, the Nicaea council and late Roman government. Its broad catalogue date spans those events; the portrait expresses imperial authority rather than recording either meeting.
interpretation.zh: 这枚同时代钱币提供了君士坦丁的实物图像；他的活动关联米兰措施、尼西亚会议及晚期罗马政府。目录的宽泛年代涵盖这些事件，头像表现皇帝权威，而非两次会议的现场。

items.creator: Unknown

alt.en: A mounted photograph shows four colossal seated figures cut into a cliff, one partly broken, with sand beside the façade and a small person at its base.
alt.zh: 装裱照片显示崖壁中凿出的四尊巨型坐像，其中一尊部分损毁；立面旁积有沙土，底部可见一个微小人影。

caption.en: Félix Bonfils, Égypte: Temple d’Abou-Simbel, Nubie, 1877. Tinted albumen silver print; Getty 84.XO.1167.15. The Great Temple stands in its cliff setting long before the 1960s relocation.
caption.zh: 费利克斯·邦菲尔斯，《埃及：努比亚的阿布辛贝神庙》，1877年。着色蛋白银盐照片；盖蒂84.XO.1167.15。照片中的大神庙仍处于二十世纪六十年代搬迁之前的崖壁环境。

interpretation.en: The original cliff, monumental façade and surrounding sand provide a dated view of the temple before the engineering project described in the entry. This 1877 photograph preserves an earlier landscape; the relocated temples reopened in 1968.
interpretation.zh: 原有崖壁、宏伟立面和周围沙土，为本条所述工程之前的神庙提供了有年代的景观记录。这张1877年照片保留较早环境，搬迁后的神庙于1968年重新开放。

title.zh: 圣礼拜堂与卡佩王朝的神圣王权

alt.en: An elevated view shows Sainte-Chapelle’s steep roof, slender spire, tall windows and buttresses among surrounding Paris rooftops.
alt.zh: 俯视照片显示巴黎屋顶间圣礼拜堂的陡峭屋面、纤细尖塔、高窗与扶壁。

caption.en: Bisson Frères, La Sainte-Chapelle, Paris, about 1854–1864. Albumen silver print; Getty 84.XM.359.3. This nineteenth-century photograph records the chapel associated with Louis IX’s royal relic patronage.
caption.zh: 比松兄弟，《巴黎圣礼拜堂》，约1854—1864年。蛋白银盐照片；盖蒂84.XM.359.3。这张十九世纪照片记录了与路易九世王室圣物资助有关的礼拜堂。

interpretation.en: Getty’s history of the relics identifies a fragment of the True Cross acquired by Louis IX and kept at Sainte-Chapelle. The named monument makes royal religious patronage tangible, while the photograph’s later date records its nineteenth-century appearance.
interpretation.zh: 盖蒂的圣物研究指出，路易九世购得的一块真十字架碎片曾保存于圣礼拜堂。这座具名古迹让王室宗教资助变得具体；照片年代较晚，记录的是其十九世纪面貌。

items.credit: J. Paul Getty Museum, Los Angeles; 84.XM.359.3

title.en: One ruler, several titles: Rudolf II’s medal
title.zh: 一位君主、多重头衔：鲁道夫二世纪念章

alt.en: An oval gold medal shows a bearded ruler in three-quarter view with laurel wreath and ruff, encircled by a Latin inscription naming imperial and royal titles.
alt.zh: 椭圆金质纪念章上是戴月桂冠与褶领的有须君主四分之三侧面像，周围拉丁铭文列出皇帝及国王头衔。

caption.en: Unknown maker, Medal of Emperor Rudolf II, about 1600, Prague. Gold; Getty 92.NJ.87. The visible inscription names Rudolf as Roman emperor and king of Hungary and Bohemia.
caption.zh: 佚名制作者，《鲁道夫二世皇帝纪念章》，约1600年，布拉格。黄金；盖蒂92.NJ.87。可见铭文称鲁道夫为罗马皇帝、匈牙利及波希米亚国王。

interpretation.en: The medal places distinct imperial and royal titles around a single Habsburg portrait, giving concrete form to overlapping offices. Its luxurious image promotes Rudolf’s authority; the named titles describe claims and status rather than uniform government across all his lands.
interpretation.zh: 纪念章把不同的皇帝与国王头衔环绕于同一哈布斯堡肖像，使职位重叠变得具体。华贵图像宣扬鲁道夫的权威；这些头衔表示权利主张与地位，而非其全部领地实行一致治理。

items.creator: Unknown

title.en: The siege of Jerusalem in a medieval manuscript
title.zh: 中世纪手稿中的耶路撒冷围城

alt.en: An illuminated page shows soldiers attacking a walled city, a crowned ruler seated beside tents, a gold-checkered sky, two text columns and colorful leafy borders.
alt.zh: 彩饰手稿页描绘士兵进攻城墙环绕的城市、帐篷旁端坐的戴冠统治者、金色棋盘格天空、两栏文字及彩色枝叶边饰。

caption.en: Boucicaut Master, The Destruction of Jerusalem, about 1413–1415, Paris. Tempera, gold and ink; Getty Ms. 63, fol. 237. The miniature retells the Roman siege of 70 CE through medieval armor and architecture.
caption.zh: 布西科大师，《耶路撒冷的毁灭》，约1413—1415年，巴黎。蛋彩、金与墨；盖蒂第63号手稿，第237叶。细密画借中世纪盔甲和建筑重述公元70年的罗马围城。

interpretation.en: Made over thirteen centuries after the siege, this image records medieval Christian reception of the event. Getty identifies an anti-Jewish theological framing in the manuscript’s pairing with Adam and Eve. That polemic belongs to the later work; the miniature supplies evidence for its makers’ beliefs rather than an eyewitness account of 70 CE.
interpretation.zh: 作品晚于围城逾十三个世纪，记录中世纪基督徒对该事件的接受。盖蒂指出，手稿把此画与亚当和夏娃配对，带有反犹太的神学框架。这种论说属于后世作品；细密画为制作者的观念提供证据，而非公元70年的目击记录。

items.credit: J. Paul Getty Museum, Los Angeles; 96.MR.17.237

title.en: A Mandalay monastery after the monarchy
title.zh: 君主制结束后的曼德勒寺院

alt.en: A wooden building with many carved, tiered spires stands beside banana plants and trees; several people appear in the courtyard and near its raised base.
alt.zh: 多座雕饰层叠尖塔的木建筑立于芭蕉与树木旁；庭院及抬高的基座附近可见数人。

caption.en: Felice Beato, Kyoung at Mandalay – Master Mess House, 1887–1897. Albumen silver print; Getty 2007.26.203.16. Getty identifies this monastery as a dining facility occupied by British troops after annexation.
caption.zh: 费利切·贝亚托，《曼德勒寺院——主伙房》，1887—1897年。蛋白银盐照片；盖蒂2007.26.203.16。盖蒂确认，这座寺院在吞并之后被英军占用为用餐场所。

interpretation.en: The photograph records the reuse of a religious building in the Konbaung dynasty’s final capital after the monarchy fell in 1885. Its date and identified military function connect the visible architecture to the colonial transition described in the entry.
interpretation.zh: 照片记录了1885年君主制覆灭后，贡榜王朝最后都城内一座宗教建筑被改作他用的情况。照片年代与已确认的军事用途，把眼前建筑与本条所述殖民转折联系起来。

items.credit: J. Paul Getty Museum, Los Angeles; 2007.26.203.16

context.en: The coin depicts Constantine, explicitly named with Licinius in the entry’s translated account of the 313 arrangements. Its 307–337 catalogue date supplies a contemporary portrait, while the entry’s textual sources establish the policy.
context.zh: 钱币描绘君士坦丁，本条关于313年措施的译文明确将他与李锡尼并列。目录所定307—337年提供同时代肖像；政策内容由条目文字来源支持。

context.en: The coin portrays Constantine, whom the entry identifies as convener of the 325 council. It connects the named imperial participant to a surviving reign object; the broad catalogue date does not establish a council issue.
context.zh: 钱币描绘本条所述325年会议召集者君士坦丁，将具名皇帝与现存在位时期实物联系起来。宽泛目录年代并不能证明它为会议而铸。

context.en: Constantine is a central named ruler in the entry’s account of late Roman government. His surviving bronze coin provides direct evidence of imperial representation within the period.
context.zh: 君士坦丁是本条晚期罗马政府叙述中具名的重要统治者。这枚现存铜币为该时期的皇帝形象提供直接证据。

context.en: The original cliff, monumental façade and surrounding sand provide a dated view of the temple before the engineering project described in the entry. This 1877 photograph preserves an earlier landscape; the relocated temples reopened in 1968.
context.zh: 原有崖壁、宏伟立面和周围沙土，为本条所述工程之前的神庙提供了有年代的景观记录。这张1877年照片保留较早环境，搬迁后的神庙于1968年重新开放。

context.en: Getty transcribes the medal’s distinct Hungarian and Bohemian royal titles alongside the imperial title. The inscription gives a dated example of crowns held together by a Habsburg ruler, the specific relationship discussed in this entry.
context.zh: 盖蒂转录了纪念章中与帝号并列的匈牙利及波希米亚王号。铭文为哈布斯堡君主持有多顶王冠提供有年代的实例，直接对应本条讨论的关系。

context.en: The visible imperial title and separate Hungarian and Bohemian kingships make the distinction between imperial office and Habsburg crowns legible. This is courtly self-presentation around 1600 within the empire’s longer history.
context.zh: 可见帝号与另列的匈牙利、波希米亚王号，具体呈现帝位和哈布斯堡诸王冠的区别。这是帝国更长历史中约1600年的宫廷自我表现。

Getty identifies an anti-Jewish theological framing in the manuscript’s pairing with Adam and Eve. That polemic belongs to the later work; the miniature supplies evidence for its makers’ beliefs rather than an eyewitness account of 70 CE.
